title: Cyberattack on Fireworks AI allowed hackers to access Notion customers’ chat transcripts
reason: A security breach exposing customer data at a major AI inference provider is a significant trust and security event.

sources.summary: This is Fireworks' second data breach in as many months.

title: Bitcoin firm Nakamoto owes Kraken $165 million, more than its entire market value
reason: A major treasury firm owing more than its market cap is a significant solvency risk indicator for the sector.

sources.summary: About 70% of the bitcoin treasury firm’s coins are pledged to the exchange, bought at roughly $118,000 each, and bitcoin now trades under $69,000.
